name: Direction
roles: Data governance board; Chief data officer
may: Set data policy, standards and risk appetite; Resolve escalations between owners; Approve exceptions above an owner's authority
may_not: Edit records or quality rules directly

name: Asset accountability
may: Approve classification, access policy and sharing; Approve changes to the meaning of data items; Accept risks and approve exceptions for their assets; Approve retention and disposal
may_not: Change systems or data directly, without the custodian

name: Stewardship
roles: Data steward; Catalogue manager; Data quality lead or analyst
may: Maintain catalogue records, glossary definitions and metadata; Set and run quality rules within the owner's targets; Propose changes to meaning, access or classification
may_not: Change classification or approve sharing; Change a definition's meaning without the owner

name: Custody and operation
may: Run storage, backups and technical access controls; Carry out approved access changes, fixes and disposal
may_not: Grant access without approval; Change what data means

name: Use
may: Use the data for the agreed purpose; Report problems and request access or changes
may_not: Change master data; Share the data on without approval
